title: Solve simultaneous covariance capacity only for a supplied actual catalogue
statement: For a fixed actual rational positive covariance catalogue with PSD H_i, gradient columns G_i in range(H_i), positive weights w_i and cubic target columns L, capacity.py solves H_i Y_i=G_i, forms W=sum_i w_i G_i^T Y_i, solves WV=L, and returns sources w_i Y_i V and cost matrix L^T V/2. The source states simultaneous Loewner-minimal cost for this catalogue and provides an exact range annihilator on failure. Its quotient removes a positive-definite translation block and charges the residual correlation target. verify_field.py admits only an actual supplied compatible Fourier field, reconstructs its covariance and all twelve cubic moments, and checks the resulting budget; it does not acquire a catalogue, grant a gradient selector or decide full-face QC.

requires: Retained F_star, every globally ROC polynomial with leading cF_star,c>0 and all twelve admitted cubic modes; actual compatible Fourier gradient
Four frequencies (1,0),(0,1),(1,1),(2,1) with gradient rays E11,E22,ones(2,2),(4,2;2,1); independent real amplitudes and two relative phases, all means and common proper output rotations

A single positive covariance exchange funds both cubic targets; literal rational profiles, Young parameters and all24 squared-amplitude ordering cones supply actual positive remainders; zero-amplitude cases are separately handled
Mixed finite collections use the stated 9^j separation, divided potential amplitudes and independent block parameters; no arbitrary-network closure

assumptions: In-progress producer-reported scoped construction, not a separate independent scientific audit or a final unrestricted theorem. The actual two-resonance network has four independently variable real amplitudes, all relative phases/means and common proper output rotations. Other resonance geometries/networks and global QC of the original full 28D face remain open. Earlier half-allocation optimal_inaccurate negative gap, mixed-sign charts, fixed-amplitude overlap and triad versions remain preserved. An exact range failure for one fixed covariance catalogue is not a general no-go theorem.

Capacity inputs are actual rational positive weights, PSD rank-one Hessians, gradient columns in their Hessian ranges and actual compatible target moments. Catalogue acquisition and exact arithmetic are real operations
